description:
CityRT might be the best city building game you've never heard of. It runs right on your computer with nothing to install, and it mixes the city building of Cities: Skylines 2 and SimCity 4 with a cosy, hand-drawn look.

In this video I start a brand new city in CityRT and grow it from a few streets of red-roofed houses into a full downtown with skyscrapers. Along the way we try the different building styles, the challenges and the city budget, and I even get out and walk through the streets I built. It's made by a solo developer, and honestly it surprised me.

🏙️ Would you play this over Cities: Skylines 2? Tell me in the comments!

🎮 Play CityRT: https://cityrt.com
